name: Psychic
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: Low Perception; high Occultism; high Int or Cha (based on subconscious mind); low AC; low Fortitude, moderate Reflex, high Will; low HP; low accuracy and high or extreme damage with spells; high to extreme spell DC. Abilities: Spontaneous occult spellcasting as a psychic of their level; two psi cantrips from one conscious mind (including its unique surface cantrip) and their amps, with 2 Focus Points (3 at 5th level) to spend on amps; psyche always unleashed (already counted in its damage, and never stupefied by it); the subconscious mind's psyche action

notes.attributes: High Intelligence (subconscious mind: Gathered Lore or Precise Discipline).
notes.defense: Low AC; low Fortitude, moderate Reflex, high Will; low HP.
notes.offense: Low attack bonus; high or extreme damage with spells.
notes.spells: High to extreme spell DC. Spontaneous occult spellcasting as a psychic of its level: {maxrank}. Two psi cantrips from one conscious mind (Distant Grasp, Infinite Eye, Oscillating Wave, Silent Whisper, Tangible Dream or Unbound Step), including its unique surface cantrip, and their amps, with 2 Focus Points (3 at 5th level) to spend on amps.
notes.specials: Its psyche is always unleashed (already counted in its damage, and never stupefied by it); the subconscious mind's psyche action.
